You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0008.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

cat > /tmp/build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
rw=Chem.RWMol(); coords={}

def atom(name, el, xy):
 a=Chem.Atom(el); idx=rw.AddAtom(a); coords[idx]=(xy[0],-xy[1],0); return idx
A={}
def at(name,el,x,y): A[name]=atom(name,el,(x,y)); return A[name]
# aromatic
for n,x,y in [('r1',873,47),('r2',978,107),('r3',978,231),('r4',873,291),('r5',768,231),('r6',768,107)]: at(n,'C',x,y)
# methoxy
at('om', 'O',1043,72); at('ome','C',1097,40)
# aryloxy bridge
at('oe','O',648,231)
# azepane ring
at('D','C',588,337); at('C','C',466,337); at('B','C',427,453); at('A','C',484,495); at('Naza','N',527,532); at('F','C',566,495); at('E','C',622,453)
# vinyl amide and carbonyl
at('v1','C',1098,231); at('v2','C',1158,337); at('NHv','N',1098,459)
at('X2','C',994,459); at('O2','O',942,351)
# pyrrolidine and linking carbonyl
at('J','C',926,562); at('Np','N',806,562); at('G','C',766,677); at('H','C',866,750); at('I','C',966,677)
at('X1','C',746,453); at('O1','O',785,383)
# lower peptide
at('X3','C',527,647); at('O3','O',583,676); at('La','C',421,709); at('Lch2','C',318,647); at('Lbranch','C',212,710); at('Lm1','C',145,672); at('Lm2','C',212,790)
at('NHp','N',421,800); at('X4','C',527,895); at('O4','O',626,839); at('Aa','C',527,1017); at('NMe2','N',450,1055); at('Nm1','C',390,1092); at('Nm2','C',445,1125)
at('Beta','C',631,1075); at('BMe','C',631,1144); at('Gamm','C',735,1013); at('EtMe','C',793,1049)

def bond(a,b,typ=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(A[a],A[b],typ)
# aromatic ring
ring=['r1','r2','r3','r4','r5','r6']
for i in range(6): bond(ring[i],ring[(i+1)%6],Chem.BondType.AROMATIC)
for n in ring: rw.GetAtomWithIdx(A[n]).SetIsAromatic(True)
# substituents
bond('r2','om'); bond('om','ome'); bond('r5','oe')
# azepane
for a,b in [('Naza','A'),('A','B'),('B','C'),('C','D'),('D','E'),('E','F'),('F','Naza')]: bond(a,b)
bond('D','oe')
# aryl enamine
bond('r3','v1'); bond('v1','v2',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('v2','NHv'); bond('NHv','X2'); bond('X2','O2',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('X2','J')
# pyrrolidine
for a,b in [('J','Np'),('Np','G'),('G','H'),('H','I'),('I','J')]: bond(a,b)
# link azepane carboxamide to pyrrolidine N
bond('E','X1'); bond('X1','O1',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('X1','Np')
# peptide below
bond('Naza','X3'); bond('X3','O3',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('X3','La')
bond('La','Lch2'); bond('Lch2','Lbranch'); bond('Lbranch','Lm1'); bond('Lbranch','Lm2'); bond('La','NHp'); bond('NHp','X4'); bond('X4','O4',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('X4','Aa'); bond('Aa','NMe2'); bond('NMe2','Nm1'); bond('NMe2','Nm2'); bond('Aa','Beta'); bond('Beta','BMe'); bond('Beta','Gamm'); bond('Gamm','EtMe')
# stereobonds: direction is from stereocenter out to hashed endpoint
for a,b in [('D','oe'),('J','Np'),('Aa','NMe2'),('Beta','BMe')]:
 bondobj=rw.GetBondBetweenAtoms(A[a],A[b]); bondobj.SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
m=rw.GetMol()
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for idx,xyz in coords.items(): conf.SetAtomPosition(idx,xyz)
m.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m, replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m, cleanIt=True, force=True)
print('stereo tags')
for name in ['D','J','Aa','Beta']:
 a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(A[name]); print(name,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else None)
print('smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
# add Hs, embed fresh 3D conformers
mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
# clear coordinates from input conformer to use embedding; remove conformers
mh.RemoveAllConformers()
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=0xC0FFEE; params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,params)
print('embed',res)
if res<0:
 params.useRandomCoords=True; res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mh,params); print('retry',res)
if res>=0:
 print('MMFF',AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(mh))
 AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mh,maxIters=1000)
 # verify chirality
 Chem.AssignStereochemistry(mh,cleanIt=True,force=True)
 for name in ['D','J','Aa','Beta']:
  a=mh.GetAtomWithIdx(A[name]); print('final',name,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else None)
 with open('/mnt/data/answer.xyz','w') as f:
  conf=mh.GetConformer(); f.write(f'{mh.GetNumAtoms()}\n3D structure generated from mol_0008.png\n')
  for a in mh.GetAtoms():
   p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx()); f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n')
 print('saved /mnt/data/answer.xyz',mh.GetNumAtoms())
PY

# aromatic bonds
ring=['r1','r2','r3','r4','r5','r6']

for n in ring: rw.GetAtomWithIdx(A[n]).SetIsAromatic(True)
bond('r2','om'); bond('om','ome'); bond('r5','oe')

bond('D','oe')
bond('r3','v1'); bond('v1','v2',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('v2','NHv'); bond('NHv','X2'); bond('X2','O2',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('X2','J')
for a,b in [('J','Np'),('Np','G'),('G','H'),('H','I'),('I','J')]: bond(a,b)
bond('E','X1'); bond('X1','O1',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('X1','Np')
bond('Naza','X3'); bond('X3','O3',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('X3','La')
bond('La','Lch2'); bond('Lch2','Lbranch'); bond('Lbranch','Lm1'); bond('Lbranch','Lm2'); bond('La','NHp'); bond('NHp','X4'); bond('X4','O4',Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond('X4','Aa'); bond('Aa','NMe2'); bond('NMe2','Nm1'); bond('NMe2','Nm2'); bond('Aa','Beta'); bond('Beta','BMe'); bond('Beta','Gamm'); bond('Gamm','EtMe')

for a,b in [('D','oe'),('J','Np'),('Aa','NMe2'),('Beta','BMe')]:
 rw.GetBondBetweenAtoms(A[a],A[b]).SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
m=rw.GetMol(); conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for idx,xyz in coords.items(): conf.SetAtomPosition(idx,xyz)

Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,replaceExistingTags=True); Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
